steps.message: What events do I have in the next week in Simple Calendar Pro? Assume the week starts from Monday. Answer with the titles only. If there are multiples titles, format your answer in a comma separated list.
Execute: adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z'; date +%s; settings get global device_name; pm list packages | grep -Ei 'simple|calendar'"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z'; date +%s; settings get global device_name; pm list packages | grep -Ei 'simple|calendar'""
